1.t: Have We not opened your breast for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)?

2.t: And removed from you your burden.

4.t: And have We not raised high your fame?

5.t: Verily, along with every hardship is relief,

6.t: Verily, along with every hardship is relief (i.e. there is one hardship with two reliefs, so one hardship cannot overcome two reliefs).

7.t: So when you have finished (your occupation), devote yourself for Allâh’s worship.

8.t: And to your Lord (Alone) turn (all your) intentions and hopes.
